hooks.name: design-kit-session-start
hooks.command: f=$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" session-start --tool gemini

hooks.name: design-kit-before-command
hooks.command: f=$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" before-command --tool gemini

hooks.name: design-kit-after-edit
hooks.command: f=$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.designkit/scripts/hook.mjs; [ -f "$f" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; node "$f" after-edit --tool gemini
